messages:
Alex Chen: Heads up — Support just routed a compliance packet from ClinicaHealth. They require SOC2 + HIPAA controls, per-route audit logs, KMS/HSM integration, and 7-year immutable retention for audit logs. Packet link: https://drive.redwood/clinica/packet :eyes:

Priya Nair: Thanks. What's the commercial ask? sales mentioned this is a dealbreaker unless we can commit to retention and auditable exports.

Danielle Liu: Confirming — Hosted API customers currently have 90d default logs, Dedicated can do longer but storage + egress costs are non-trivial. 7y immutable retention is a big ops lift.

Jorge Martinez: From infra side: need lifecycle policy, cold storage tier, and retention-indexing. Also need convo about who pays. If customer wants onsite Private deployment we can offer longer retention w/ enterprise plan.

Alex Chen: Proposal: classify this as "enterprise compliance" triage. Short-term negotiation: offer SOC2+HIPAA attestation + 1yr retention by default, with paid extended retention addon (3y/7y) and an option for Private/Dedicated for strict immutability. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Priya Nair: +1 to that negotiation. Sales will accept a paid add-on if we can provide clear SLA and price. We should carve out acceptance criteria for the add-on so Legal feels safe.

Danielle Liu: Operational acceptance criteria suggested:
- audit log schema and per-request routing (must include request id, model, route, tenant id)
- export tool for legal requests (CSV/NDJSON), immutable snapshots for retention window
- integration test: restore + read back a sample log within RTO 6h
- cost estimate and chargeback model

Alex Chen: Adding launch checklist for product backlog ticket. Can one of you create the ticket with these fields? I can own product acceptance tests. Suggested ticket template (short):
```
Title: compliance/retention: extended-log-retention-clinicahealth
Labels: enterprise, compliance, retention, sales-ask
Priority: P1 (sales deal)
Scope: SOC2+HIPAA controls, KMS/HSM encryption at rest, per-route audit logging, retention addon (1y default, paid 3y/7y), export tool
Acceptance criteria: security review OK, e2e export test, billing sku for retention, docs + runbook
Estimate: TBD (infra + storage + dev)
```

Jorge Martinez: I'll estimate infra cost after a quick spike. Tentative: 2-3 engineer-weeks for core retention pipeline + storage lifecycle. Need input from security for HSM integration requirements.

security-bot: Security checklist requirement: must pass Key Management review, threat model for immutable storage, and encryption at rest with customer-managed keys if requested.

Priya Nair: I'll ask Sales to offer the paid retention tiers and see if customer will accept 1yr while we roadmap extended retention. If they insist on 7y as non-negotiable, escalate to VP Sales for commercial concession.

triage-bot: Created ticket #RDW-8421 and assigned to @Jorge, @Alex. Link: https://jira.redwood/browse/RDW-8421

Alex Chen: Great — next steps: Jorge spike for cost, security deep-dive, Priya commercial negotiation. I'll draft acceptance tests and doc PR. Let's sync async; want a decision by EOW so Sales can respond. :calendar:

Danielle Liu: Noted. I'll check storage quotas and potential Dedicated offering constraints and post numbers here.

Priya Nair: Thanks team — looping in @legal if needed.

Alex Chen: Closing thread for now — will update RDW-8421 with scope and acceptance criteria.
